content.short: Starknet is a decentralized ZK-Rollup that operates as an Ethereum Layer-2 scaling solution.
content.description: StarkNet is a decentralized, permissionless, and censorship-resistant Zero-Knowledge Rollup that enables general computation over Ethereum. Developers can build applications on StarkNet, allowing users to send transactions the same way they do on Ethereum today. All StarkNet transactions are batched, with their validity proven by a Stark proof, and this proof is verified on the Ethereum blockchain, ensuring correctness while maintaining the security guarantees of Ethereum.
content.meta: Starknet is a decentralized, permissionless ZK-Rollup that enables Ethereum-scale computation. Discover Starknet and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
